## Ctx.renderEditContact() method

Replaces the current message with a contact.

Template block: `<g-media>` (read via `renderEditMedia`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderEditContact(keyboardInline?: IInlineKb | null, data?: IData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options?: IOptEditMedia2 | null, fallbackEdit?: IOptFallbackEdit): Promise<unknown>;
```

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

The sent message object.

## Remarks

Contacts cannot be edited in-place, so this deletes the original and sends a new one.
